title: Signed conjugation preserves the supported tensor unit equation
statement: Fix a finite commutative ring $A$, an open immersion $i:W\hookrightarrow Y$, and actual ordinary unbounded fixed-scalar operations of [def-sf-finite-open-tensor-operations]. For $R,H\in D_A(Y)$, $P,Q\in D_A(W)$, $a:i^*R\simeq P$, $b:i^*H\simeq Q$, let $f:R\otimes H\to i_!(P\otimes Q)$ satisfy $i^*f=\mu_i;(a\otimes b);\eta^i$. Then $i^*(\sigma_{H,R};f;i_!\sigma_{P,Q})=\mu_{i;H,R};(b\otimes a);\eta^i_{Q\otimes P}$. The symmetries are the specified signed Koszul maps; no invertibility of $f$ is assumed.

proof.text: apply i* to the three factors and substitute hf. Naturality of eta moves i*i!(sigma(P,Q)) to sigma(P,Q) followed by eta(Q tensor P). Naturality of the signed braiding moves tensor(a,b) past sigma(P,Q), yielding the symmetry on i*R, i*H followed by tensor(b,a). Braiding compatibility of the canonical pullback tensor comparison moves i*(sigma(H,R)) past mu_i. The two adjacent symmetries on i*H, i*R and i*R, i*H cancel. On total-complex degrees r,s their product sign is (-1)^(rs+sr)=1, including odd degrees. These are equations on the full coproduct total tensor of flat-term K-flat representatives; the derived comparison and specified sigma are their localizations, so the equality holds for arbitrary unbounded complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem supportedTensor_signed_unit
    {W Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : W ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (R H : FiniteD A Y) (P Q : FiniteD A W)
    (a : (pull A i).obj R ≅ P) (b : (pull A i).obj H ≅ Q)
    (f : tensor A Y R H ⟶ (finiteShriek A i).obj (tensor A W P Q))
    (hf : (pull A i).map f = (tensorPullIso A i R H).hom ≫
      tensorMap A W a.hom b.hom ≫ (adj A i).unit.app (tensor A W P Q)) :
    (pull A i).map (sigma A Y H R ≫ f ≫ (finiteShriek A i).map (sigma A W P Q)) =
      (tensorPullIso A i H R).hom ≫ tensorMap A W b.hom a.hom ≫
        (adj A i).unit.app (tensor A W Q P)
